description: The system shall be available in both Spanish and English.
The system shall allow the registration of new users.
The system shall authenticate existing users via email.
The system shall allow users to log out.
The system shall allow logged-in users to view company profiles and their products.
The system shall store images of all products and users.
A company shall be able to modify its public profile and preview it while editing.
A company shall have access to a dashboard for internal functionalities and information.
A company shall be able to register a product to be visible on its public profile.
A company shall be able to register a route and link it to its products.
A user shall be able to return a product registered by a company using its routes.
Every route shall have an associated cost that the user must pay through the system when returning a product.
The system shall provide an affiliation/plan system for companies (free, basic, and premium).
The system shall be available in different languages.
The system shall be available in both Spanish and English, verified by a translator.
The user interface must be intuitive and easy to use for non-technical users.
Usability testing with at least 10 representative users shall achieve a minimum satisfaction score of 8/10.
The system must protect user information through secure authentication.
The system must pass security audits without critical vulnerabilities.
The system must have 99.9% uptime and be able to recover from failures in less than 1 hour.
Uptime monitoring shall demonstrate 99.9% availability and disaster recovery tests shall meet the specified recovery time.
The system must be easy to maintain and update with clear and complete documentation.
Average time for implementing updates and resolving issues shall not exceed 2 hours.
The system must be compatible with common web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile devices.
Compatibility tests shall demonstrate functionality across major browsers and mobile devices.
The system must be scalable to handle an increase in the number of users and data volume.
The system shall maintain performance with a 50% increase in workload.
Company products/routes/profiles can only be edited and accessed by that company.
Verify that only the company user can access their products/routes/profile.
